high_level_description: The image depicts a golden staff with an ornate design. The top of the staff features a bust of a man's head, which is intricately detailed and appears to be made of the same golden material as the rest of the staff. The bust has a serious expression and is adorned with a high collar that extends down the neck and shoulders. The staff itself is long and cylindrical, with a smooth surface that reflects light, giving it a polished appearance.
